definitions.explanation: A person's history of formal education, including schools attended and degrees obtained.

examples.japanese: ⟦{履歴書|りれきしょ}→履歴書：04691_rirekisho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{学歴|がくれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
examples.english: To write one's educational background on a resume.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{学歴|がくれき}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧だ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: Japan is said to be an education-focused society.
examples.notes: {学歴|がくれき}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ = society that values educational credentials

examples.japanese: ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧{学歴|がくれき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あっても→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つからない→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: Even with high educational credentials, I can't find a job.

notes:
{学歴|がくれき} refers to one's formal educational credentials.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {学歴|がくれき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦{低|ひく}い→低い：02947_hikui⟧ (high/low educational background)
- {学歴|がくれき}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{問|と}わない→問う：02299_tou⟧ (regardless of educational background)
- {学歴|がくれき}⟦{詐称|さしょう}→詐称：18658_sashou⟧ (falsification of academic credentials)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {学歴|がくれき}⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧ (credential-focused society)
- {学歴|がくれき}⟦{差別|さべつ}→差別：01633_sabetsu⟧ (educational discrimination)
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧{学歴|がくれき} (highest level of education)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {学歴|がくれき}: educational background
- ⟦{経歴|けいれき}→経歴：13795_keireki⟧: career history
- ⟦{職歴|しょくれき}→職歴：17959_shokureki⟧: work history
